project: E2E-0001 Seeded Matters Citation Highlight + Review
description: Deterministic e2e scenario proving the trust UX: click citation -> PDF renders with highlight overlay, and review state persists.
overview: Protect the core trust moment of the PoC: seeded Matters UI renders deterministic rows with citation chips that open a viewer showing a highlight overlay. Also covers explicit review state transitions (needs_review -> reviewed) persisted to the seed snapshot.
goals: Prove click-to-highlight evidence works end-to-end on pack_01_clean without OCR/LLM dependencies.
Prove review state is explicit and persisted across refresh.
Provide machine-executable acceptance criteria for automation.
nonGoals: DB-backed ingest/index pipeline and Quick Start workflow execution.
OCR/layout extraction correctness (this scenario uses fixture PDFs + seeded snapshots).
successMetrics: Viewer renders at least one highlight polygon for a known-good citation on pack_01_clean.
Mark reviewed persists across refresh and is visible as a status change in the UI.
Negative case: invalid citation id yields a user-visible error state with a back link.
openQuestions: Primary automation harness: Playwright vs agent-driven DOM runner.
Should review-state mutation be mandatory in the e2e suite or covered by a separate integration test?

routes.name: Seeded Matters
routes.purpose: List seeded rows with citation chips and review controls.

routes.name: Citation Viewer
routes.purpose: Render PDF page with highlight overlay for a locked citation.

notes: This scenario targets dev-only routes guarded by assertDevOnly().
Tests should re-seed with --overwrite because Mark reviewed mutates tmp/fixture-seed/*.

stories.title: Citation Viewer Highlight + Review Persistence
stories.description: As a reviewer, I can mark a seeded row reviewed and click a citation chip to see the cited evidence highlighted in the PDF viewer (or an explicit fail-closed error state).
acceptanceCriteria: Example: Seed pack_01_clean snapshot via `pnpm fixture:seed pack_01_clean --overwrite` and run `pnpm dev` (dev-only routes).
Navigate to `/matters?pack=pack_01_clean` and assert page title `Matters` and the `pack_id: pack_01_clean` summary are visible.
Assert row `TS-01` exists with status `needs_review` and includes citation chip text `cit_TS-01_1`.
Click `Mark reviewed` on row `TS-01` and assert redirect contains `reviewed=TS-01`, row status updates to `reviewed`, and the success banner `Saved` / `Marked as reviewed.` is visible.
Refresh the page and assert row `TS-01` remains `reviewed` (persisted to seed snapshot).
Click citation chip `cit_TS-01_1` and assert the viewer does NOT show a `citation_failed` panel, and that the highlight `<svg>` contains at least one `<polygon>` element.
Assert the viewer shows `Locked to 100% while highlighting` and the Zoom select is disabled while the overlay is active.
Negative: Navigate to `/matters/viewer?pack=pack_01_clean&citation=DOES_NOT_EXIST` and assert `Citation not found: DOES_NOT_EXIST` plus a `Back to matters` link to `/matters?pack=pack_01_clean`.

userStories.title: Citation Viewer Highlight + Review Persistence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I can mark a seeded row reviewed and click a citation chip to see the cited evidence highlighted in the PDF viewer (or an explicit fail-closed error state).
acceptanceCriteria: Seed pack_01_clean snapshot via `pnpm fixture:seed pack_01_clean --overwrite` and run `pnpm dev`.
Navigate to `/matters?pack=pack_01_clean` and assert `pack_id: pack_01_clean` is visible.
Assert row `TS-01` exists with status `needs_review` and a citation chip `cit_TS-01_1`.
Click `Mark reviewed` on `TS-01`; assert redirect contains `reviewed=TS-01`, status is `reviewed`, and success banner is visible; refresh persists.
Click `cit_TS-01_1`; assert no `citation_failed` panel and at least one highlight `<polygon>` is rendered.
Negative: `/matters/viewer?pack=pack_01_clean&citation=DOES_NOT_EXIST` shows `Citation not found` and a back link.
